How to review this flow:
  • Balance starts at 10 credits with controls enabled and no Play Again button (AC 3).
  • Click Spin (bet 10) to lose the bet. Balance drops to 0: spin controls disable and Play Again appears and is automatically focused (AC 1, 2, 9) — confirm with Tab/Shift+Tab that focus lands there.
  • Activate Play Again with a click, or via keyboard (Tab to it, then Enter/Space) (AC 8). It disables immediately, before the balance changes (AC 12) — try activating it again while disabled to confirm no second reset fires (AC 13).
  • After the simulated reinit, balance resets to 1,000, Last Bet/Spin History/Win Total return to defaults (AC 4, 11), spin controls re-enable (AC 5), and the status region above announces both changes (AC 10) — all with no page reload and the same canvas instance badge as before (AC 6, 7).
